Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, ax As Object, vx As Object, gl As Object
    Dim s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory): Set vx = ch.Axes(xlValue)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        vx.MajorGridlines.Delete
    Case 2
        Set gl = ax.MajorGridlines
    Case 3
        Set gl = vx.MinorGridlines
    Case 4
        ax.HasMajorGridlines = True: ax.MajorGridlines.Delete
    Case 5
        vx.HasMinorGridlines = True: vx.MinorGridlines.Delete
    Case 6
        ws.Range("B2:C4").NumberFormat = "0.00"
    Case 7
        vx.TickLabels.NumberFormat = "0%"
    Case 8
        vx.TickLabels.NumberFormat = "0%": vx.TickLabels.NumberFormatLinked = True
    Case 9
        vx.TickLabels.NumberFormatLinked = False
    Case 10
        ax.TickLabels.NumberFormat = "@"
    Case 11
        vx.TickLabels.NumberFormatLocal = "0.0"
    Case 12
        vx.TickLabels.NumberFormat = "General"
    Case 13
        vx.TickLabels.NumberFormat = "nonsense"
    Case 14
        ax.HasMajorGridlines = True: vx.HasMinorGridlines = True: ax.HasMinorGridlines = True
    Case 15
        vx.HasMinorGridlines = True: vx.HasMajorGridlines = False
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.HasMajorGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.HasMinorGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.HasMajorGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.HasMinorGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.NumberFormat
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.NumberFormatLinked
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.NumberFormatLocal
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.NumberFormat
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.NumberFormatLinked
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.Orientation
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.Orientation
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.Offset
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.Offset
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.Alignment
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.Alignment
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.Depth
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.Depth
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.MultiLevel
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.TickLabels.MultiLevel
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.TickLabels.ReadingOrder
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(vx.TickLabels.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(vx.TickLabels.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.MajorGridlines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(vx.MajorGridlines.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(vx.MajorGridlines.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.HasMajorGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & vx.MinorGridlines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.MajorGridlines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ax.MinorGridlines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
